summary: Oil-Dri Corporation of America filed a Form 8-K reporting entry into two amended financing arrangements rather than a special situation. On October 7, 2026, the company amended its BMO credit agreement, raising the revolver from $75 million to $100 million, expanding the accordion to the greater of $125 million or 100% of Consolidated EBITDA, cutting pricing, extending maturity to October 7, 2031, and adding a restricted-payments covenant. It separately amended its Prudential note agreement, extending shelf issuance to October 7, 2029 and raising shelf capacity from $75 million to $150 million. No deal terms or board recommendation apply; watch covenant headroom and buyback capacity.
